title: World Bloom — To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage — Episode7 Under the Surface

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage
meta.Event Outline: On MORE MORE JUMP!'s first free day in quite some time, they have been enjoying school life to the full. Their recent TV appearance has caused a buzz among their classmates, renewing their determination to keep working their hardest. That's when they each find themselves in an unfamiliar part of SEKAI...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is so strange...
I didn't realize new areas could just suddenly appear in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Isn't it incredible?
We couldn't believe it either when we first discovered it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We wanted to tell everyone right away, but we couldn't find Miku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which is why we came over to tell you about it, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, if you had trouble finding them, then they may be here already.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, good point...!
Do you think we'll find them if we walk around for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, let's explore while also keeping an eye out for them, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's happening again...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You mean the rain that isn't rain?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It hasn't been coming down all that hard, but it's been on and off for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but these droplets don't feel wet whatsoever. Actually, they're a little warm for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know what you mean.
They feel all warm and cozy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means it isn't your normal kind of rain. And do you think this pond was created by it...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you're right, then it also won't make us wet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that is a possibility.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't you try sticking your hand in, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?!
Why me?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't mind doing it, but you sounded more interested in finding out♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I'm curious...
But also a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?!
A-Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. As far as I can tell, this looks like ordinary water, but I'm sensing nothing ominous about it. There even seems to be something sparkling at the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born out of our feelings, so I'm convinced that there's nothing dangerous about it...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... And that rain didn't feel bad or anything either...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you gotta tell us if something happens, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And we'll dive in to help if you fall in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then, here I go...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? This light...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! All the light from the lake's gathering around Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on...?
It feels so warm and...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Where am I...?
Great show today, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, that's...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for coming again today. And I really appreciate you seeing me out like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Huh? Is that me...?!)

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure!
I really wanted to tell you how much I liked your performance!

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: And you put on another absolutely astonishing show today! Your singing and dancing were so perfect... I really admire you...

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: I can't do what you do, Shizuku, but I always think about how hard you work and what I can do to become more like you whenever things aren't going well for me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That's right. This person has followed me wherever I went since I debuted...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She even said that her favorite thing to do was come see shows at the theatre since it wasn't very big. It gave her a chance to see me right up close.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But why am I being sent back to this time all of a sudden...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Why this memory...?)

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: But I've noticed that Cheerful * Days hasn't been doing as many shows at the theatre after becoming more well known.

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: Of course, I'm happy that more and more people have started following Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: I do feel a bit conflicted since I've been following you from the very beginning...

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean I'm going to stop cheering for you! So, please keep doing your best...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Back then, I did what I could to put on the best performances I could at the theatre, and I always looked forward to seeing that person there...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But our group's popularity just kept rising after that. We had no choice but to reduce the number of performances we did there in order to accommodate our other offers for work...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(As a result, that person...
She started only coming to see us every once in a while.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Right. As our group became more famous, more and more people like her started feeling like they were getting left behind. That's been lingering in the back of my mind for so long...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That's why I'm so afraid that the same thing is going to happen to MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh...?
The light's flashing again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Th-This is...!
Our solo show...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wh-What am I doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, this is just the beginning!
Try to keep up, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Louder, everyone! Louder!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Until you lose your voices!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why am being shown this now?

Shizuku!!!
You're the best!!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh...?
That voice...

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: (I don't care if I can't see you at that theatre anymore. I don't care that the current you is different from the person I saw in Cheerful * Days...)

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: (I'm your fan because I know how hard you work to stand on that stage.)

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: (No, I abandoned you once, so I have no right to call myself your fan. But I'm going to keep cheering for you as long as I live. So...)

rows.Speaker: Fan
rows.Line: Please let me keep supporting you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You came to see our show...
I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I ended up causing you so much pain...
And yet, you were willing to keep cheering for me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
For understanding what we're trying to do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow... You really got to see what that fan of yours was thinking while you were engulfed in that light?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, before you two came over to get me, I was talking to Saito about how we may end up disappointing our oldest and most loyal fans as our group's activities evolve.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But...
I feel much better after hearing her thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even if what we do changes, as long as my determination doesn't, my thoughts will reach everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're so strong, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Strong? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I mean...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Despite the current you being very different from the Cheerful * Days you, you've never once given up on trying to reach your fans, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've never given up...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A lot about you has changed, but that hasn't. You've been able to get everyone to understand what you're thinking and feeling.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Which is why I agree.
You're such an incredibly strong person.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, as long as you keep doing that, you should be totally fine moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Because everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! is really amazing. You, in particular, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Now I see...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That must've been what Saito was trying to say to me earlier...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What happened when I was still in Cheerful * Days may still end up happening to us. As things change moving forward, we may end up disappointing our fans...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Spreading hope to them will still remain our priority. We aren't going to stop reaching out to them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll continue trying until they understand.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, and we'll be rooting for you all!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're very much looking forward to seeing how things unfold for MORE MORE JUMP! in the future!
Huh? Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We didn't know you were also here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're all here too...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, thank goodness!
We've been looking all over for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To be fair, we were sort of exploring at the same time♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Actually, I think we were all sort of doing the same thing just now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems that way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But we still haven't seen Minori or Miku anywhere. We thought they were with you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, we haven't seen them either.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you think they're doing right now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm...
